note_nb: Dialogtider er målt fra de ferdige opptakene: start/slutt for tale, i sekunder fra starten av hvert klipp. Stille undersøkelsestekst styres av interaksjon. VHS-tider er kun planlagte.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: Good afternoon, Caliche. Hope your Sunday has been an easy one.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: We've still got a little sunshine left. Good time to get the washing off the line.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: A reminder from the feed store: tomorrow's delivery comes in after ten. Let them have their coffee first.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: And if you're heading out to work, the diner has the griddle on.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: Take it easy through town. There's no prize for getting to the next red light first.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: Here's another record for the road.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Hi there. Sit wherever you like.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Kitchen's still going. Coffee's fresh enough that I can say it with a straight face.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: You want to see the menu, or are you just stretching your legs?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Burger comes with fries. Sandwich comes with chips.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Coffee with either one. I can wrap the food if you're taking it to work.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: What sounds good?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: One burger, fries and coffee. Coming right up.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: There you go. Careful with the plate.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Eating here, or shall I wrap it?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Sandwich, chips and coffee. You got it.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Here we are. Napkins are right beside you.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Staying for a minute, or taking that along?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Sure. Take your time.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Mind if I top that coffee up?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: There. That should keep you going.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Thanks for stopping in. Have a good shift.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: No trouble. I'll put it in a bag.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Fork and napkins are in there. Coffee's got a lid.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Keep the bag upright. The bottom's got more confidence than strength.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Have a good evening out there.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: You've caught us between the supper crowd and the coffee crowd.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Nice having a minute to wipe a table before somebody needs it.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Let me know if you change your mind about food.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: All right. Thanks for coming in.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: We're here if you need something later.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Drive safely.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: You're listening to local radio here in Caliche.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: Church supper volunteers, your pans are clean and waiting in the kitchen. Please take yours home before somebody makes another casserole in it.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: We'll leave you with some music now.

lines.speaker: RADIO_HOST
lines.text: Good evening to everybody starting work, and everybody heading home.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Hi again. Back from SARO?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Coffee's on. You can sit down a minute.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: That driver came in a little while ago. He's over there if you're looking for somebody who's been on the road.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: There's a paper on the counter, too. Nobody's claimed it.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Evening. Coming in from work?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Take a seat if you need one. Coffee's on.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: That fellow over there just came off the road. He's been sitting with his cup for a while.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Paper's on the counter if you want something to read.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Keep on through town, then take the marked turn out to the array.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Big sign. Hard to miss unless you're arguing with the radio.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: You'll want to eat before you get settled in out there.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Want the menu before you go?

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: If you're hungry, the burger.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: If you're driving, the sandwich is less of a project.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Either way, I'm putting napkins in the bag.

lines.speaker: WAITRESS
lines.text: Your call.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Reyes? Dale. The logbook should be in front of you.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I headed out early. The service folder is on the desk, under the work order.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The first survey is routine. Check calibration before you let it run.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Did you get something to eat?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Good. Better than trying to live on the coffee here.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I tried that once. Wouldn't recommend it.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: There are crackers in the bottom drawer. Still in the wrapper.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: No promises about the coffee. It was here when I came in.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Start with the log. I've marked what's done and what's left for you.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Bank Three has two amber indicators. Amber is normal. Write it down if that changes.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Your folder lists the local service records and the radio schedule. Get the dated copies. We need something to check our clocks against.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Operations office is locked. The papers for tonight are already on your desk.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Ward is on call for the morning run. She wants observations she can sign, not our best guess.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: You can reach me on the service line. If something doesn't fit the log, call before you throw anything away.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: All right. Have a good shift.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Dale. You have the service sheet?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Then start with the feeder marked on that sheet. A receiver warning and a supply fault are two different things.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The junction station is down the short gravel turnoff. Leave the truck outside the service gate.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Use the service check on the cabinet. Note what the affected light does, not just what the indicator says.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: There should be one clear result. If the result is not clear, leave it unresolved and call me.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I hear you. Check the cabinet label against the service sheet.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: If they match, run the check and watch the light at the far end.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Write down the result and the time. Keep that for the next check.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Dale. What did it actually print?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Minus thirty-nine. On the paper?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Keep the original. Put the clock reading beside it before you do anything else.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Do not correct the number just because it looks wrong.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I've seen numbers that shouldn't have come out of that solver.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I haven't worked out why. I kept the records.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Keep yours too. We can argue about the explanation later.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Check your inspection card. Put the test time beside the new printout.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: If you've cleared the supply fault, compare that time with this one.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: All right. Put the paper somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Call me if the next observation disagrees with the first one.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: You found a spare.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I should have told you there was more than a service folder.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Ward wants a result somebody else can repeat. She's right to.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I had clippings, bad frames and people who remembered different nights.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I kept the lot until I could put two observations on the same page.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Watch the pole, not the patch.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The patch could be a recording fault. The pole gives you a fixed reference.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Use the field sheet. I marked the camera position.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I haven't worked through those survey files.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The folder in my office is my own. I haven't changed an old report.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Keep the originals together. Check whose name is on the signed copy.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Start with one thing you can check. Take a photograph from the same place.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: And don't take my word for something just because I wrote it down.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Say that again. The service result and the light disagree?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: You checked the ordinary supply, the backup and the indicator?

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Good. Write down every check you made. Keep that separate from what you think caused it.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Bring the record back to SARO. Ward will need to read it.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Reyes? I'm here.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: If you've got witness statements, keep their exact words with the record.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Give Ward what you've actually checked. Leave the rest marked uncertain.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Call me when you get back in.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Reyes? Dale. The logbook should be in front of you.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: OPERATIONS. The handle gives a little, then stops. A paper label beside the lock reads: SPARE IN SERVICE DRAWER.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A coffee ring has spread across the word SPARE.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Fuses, a bulb in a cardboard sleeve, two pencils worn down to the metal. A small brass key is taped beneath the drawer label.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The tag reads OPERATIONS / SPARE.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The spare turns once. The latch catches on the frame until you lift the handle.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: An ordinary office: a desk lamp, a coat over the chair, invoices clipped to a board. There is a clean patch on the desk where somebody usually puts a mug.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A lunch receipt holds down a stack of maintenance forms. Someone has written MILK on the back.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Under the invoices is a folder marked FIELD CHECKS. The label is newer than the folder. A pencilled list names a tape, a service-road photograph and two newspaper cuttings.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The first page lists what each item can establish. Most entries end with a question or a correction.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Two local cuttings, neither about a crash. A third rectangle on the page is empty.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: In the margin: GET THE ORIGINAL BEFORE USING THE DATE.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The note starts as a list of things to check. Halfway down, the handwriting gets smaller.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A contact card has been tucked under the telephone. There are no names on the back. Just the word FIELD, underlined twice.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A handwritten sleeve: SERVICE ROAD / FIELD 01. The tape counter has been copied onto the label.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: There is no narration listed. The note on the sleeve says: WATCH THE POST, THEN THE LINE.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The tape runs on past the movement. Wind, the fence, the same stretch of wire. Then the counter stops.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The final card gives a place to stand: the low culvert outside the service gate, beside the post with two white bands.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The field sheet locates the camera outside the substation fence, beside a low culvert and a post painted with two white bands.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: It asks for a comparison from the same position, with the nearest pole and both conductors in frame. The tape may help explain what to look for.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The service copy records an open inspection complaint. The radio sheet is a programme schedule, not a recording of the broadcast.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Both copies are dated. Neither tells you what will happen later tonight.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The residual is on the new printout. The service copy predates it.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The old complaint and this printout belong on the same timeline. That does not make them the same event.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The copy records a complaint and an inspection request. It does not record the supply at the moment of the residual.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Use the actual inspection result and the later observation. The dates alone cannot settle the cause.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Comparison filed: earlier service complaint; later residual. A shared cause is not established.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Keep the actual inspection result with the printout.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: From the first position, the bright edge resembles a person behind the glass.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: From the side, it follows the room lamp. The photograph shows the same reflection.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Inspection circuit. The open complaint describes a weak exterior lamp, not a failure of the observatory receiver.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The label on the service card matches the marked inspection front.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The service check compares the panel result with the actual inspection light.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Watch the marked light after the test. Do not file a result from the indicator alone.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The completed service check and the inspection light now agree.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The ordinary lamp complaint is resolved under this control. Keep the actual completion time on the inspection card.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The check is not complete. There is no result to file yet.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The service card and the marked light are still available. Return when you can compare them.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The culvert, the two white bands and the nearest pole match the reference sheet.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The old photograph gives you a place to stand. It does not tell you which supply is carrying the light now.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The service indication, the local control and the light must be compared as separate observations.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A backup supply or a faulty indicator would be an ordinary explanation. Check those before drawing a conclusion.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The local isolation result is recorded. The checked backup does not account for the light. The indicator has been compared with the independent service check.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The marked light continues its visible sequence.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Observation filed: under these controls, the light and the service result disagree. Cause unknown.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Unresolved. The reference is useful, but the current supply and the visible light have not yet been accounted for together.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Keep the reference and your checks. An unanswered observation is not a failed case.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The price sticker and the torn lower corner match the earlier reference.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: It is the same cardboard figure. Its position has changed.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The comparison establishes position and identity. It does not show what moved the figure.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Filed: same figure, changed position. The cause remains unconfirmed.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: From inside the closed studio: the short rhythm of a printer. Then the ordinary carrier again.

beats.text:
SERVICE ROAD / FIELD 01
Camera date incorrect. Use position, not timestamp.

Road side of the two-band post.
Culvert beside the service gate.

Nearest pole and both wires in frame.
The lamp alone proves nothing about its supply.

Did the patch move with the camera?
Compare the pole, not the tracking line.

Return to this position.
Check the ordinary supply first. Then make a fresh observation.
— D.
